landing.heroDescription: A modern, interactive quiz platform designed to help students revise and master their subjects through customizable question banks, instant feedback, and a beautiful interface.

features.title: Everything you need for
features.subtitle: effective studying
features.description: QuizMaster provides all the tools you need to create, organize, and practice with custom question banks.

questionBanks.title: Question Banks
questionBanks.description: Organize questions into named banks for different subjects or topics with rich categorization.
questionBanks.detailedDescription: Create unlimited question banks for different subjects, topics, or difficulty levels. Each bank can be customized with names, descriptions, and categories. Perfect for organizing your study materials by subject, chapter, or exam type.

richEditor.title: Rich Question Editor
richEditor.description: Create questions with formatted text, multiple choices, tags, categories, and difficulty levels.
richEditor.detailedDescription: Advanced question editor with rich text formatting, multiple choice options, drag-and-drop answer ordering, difficulty levels, tags, and categories. Supports images, code snippets, and mathematical expressions.

importExport.title: Import/Export
importExport.description: Import questions from JSON files and export your data for backup or sharing.
importExport.detailedDescription: Seamlessly import questions from JSON files or export your entire question banks for backup or sharing with classmates. Supports bulk operations and maintains all question metadata.

practiceSupport.title: Practice Mode
practiceSupport.description: Take interactive quizzes with customizable settings, instant feedback, and detailed performance analytics.
practiceSupport.detailedDescription: Comprehensive practice mode with customizable quiz settings, time limits, question shuffling, instant feedback, and detailed performance analytics. Track your progress and identify areas for improvement.

step_1.title: Welcome to QuizMaster
step_1.full_description: Welcome to QuizMaster! A modern, offline-first quiz platform designed to help students create, organize, and practice with custom question banks. Let's explore what makes it special.

step_2.title: Create Question Banks
step_2.full_description: Start by creating question banks for different subjects or topics. Each bank can contain multiple questions with rich formatting, multiple choice answers, tags, and difficulty levels.

step_3.title: Rich Question Editor
step_3.full_description: Use our powerful editor to create questions with formatted text, multiple choices, correct answers, tags, categories, and notes. Drag and drop to reorder questions as needed.

step_4.title: Import & Export
step_4.full_description: Import questions from JSON files or export your question banks to share with classmates or backup your work. Everything works offline using your browser's local storage.

workspace_info.description: A $t(workspace) is like a $t(workspace) that helps you manage and organize questions by topic or subject. Each $t(workspace) contains your questions, quiz templates, and analytics all in one organized space.
